summary: Violent two-way reversal. NQ dumped over 1,000 points and the VIX spiked to nearly 35 before a V-shaped, tech-led rebound left NQ down just 0.7% and ES down 0.3%, both back above AVWAP with their 1h ATR stops flipped long. Gold rolled to February and bounced to 3,602; crude ripped 3.3% to 84.12 and closed stretched at its +2 sigma band. The close looked calm; the day traded anything but.

setups.entry: Long while price holds above the 1h ATR stops on hourly closes (MNQ 25,482, MCL 82.33)
setups.bias: Stops just flipped long on the indices; crude the cleanest trend. High whipsaw risk after a 1,000-point reversal.

setups.name: E3v2 Momentum Long (15m)
setups.entry: 15m breakout with RVOL and ROC above thresholds and price above EMA50
setups.bias: Upside momentum into the close; fresh reversal and a thin half-day Friday argue for small size.

setups.name: AVWAP Deviation Band
setups.entry: Reversion only at +/-2 or +/-3 sigma with exhaustion volume
setups.bias: MCL closed at +2 sigma (84.09), the one reversion-grade spot. Trending tape makes reversion lower-odds.

setups.name: AVWAP Bounce
setups.entry: Long on a clean hold of AVWAP as support (MNQ 25,624, MES 7,113, gold 3,533)
setups.bias: Price reclaimed AVWAP on the recovery; wants a clean hold to confirm after the whipsaw.

risk.note: Week ahead: Thursday Nov 26 is Thanksgiving (closed); Friday Nov 27 is a shortened half-day with thin liquidity and an early close. Keep size small into the holiday.

psychology: Days like this punish both sides of the emotion trade. The panic-seller at the 25,027 low and the chaser at the recovery highs both got hurt by reacting to the tape. A 1,000-point swing is not a reason to trade bigger; it is the day to trade your levels and your stop, or to sit out.

Busy open: if the first 30 minutes cover at least the number shown, expect a wider day than normal. Give trades more room.

Close at the top or bottom: do not count on follow-through at the next open.
